channel.title: NoteFlowAI project releases
channel.description: New features with verified releases and usage documentation.

item.title: Decision coverage for recorded choices
item.description: How often does a recorded choice component answer when it abstains below a confidence threshold, and how often is it wrong? EvalArc 0.16.0 chooses the threshold on calibration decisions, then reports coverage and selective error on held-out decisions. Invalid responses stay visible instead of being counted as wrong answers.

item.title: Check a skill choice against the installed shortlist
item.description: Skills Anywhere 0.16.0 adds a two-step route command. Prepare builds a shortlist of installed skills that can actually be opened; apply checks a saved choice against that shortlist before it is used. The result says whether the pick is selected, absent, below the confidence threshold, stale or invalid. The command does not load or run the skill.

item.title: stall-threshold sensitivity for recorded step-limit failures
item.description: Adds --stall-sweep T1,T2,... to python -m robot_reel.stress. It re-labels verified recorded step-limit traces at up to eight stall thresholds in metres and reports per-threshold counts, changed and stable trials, and threshold-dependent boundaries against the unchanged 1 mm reference. No policy is re-run and no threshold is validated.

item.title: report consecutive-failure streak and failing_since date for struggling sources in pairadar.health
item.description: `python3 -m pairadar.health` now tells the maintainer and the nightly repair gate whether a struggling source has been continuously dark or is flapping. Each entry under `struggling` gains two fields next to the existing `source` and `failed_days`: `streak_days`, the number of consecutive runs (counted back from the latest run that recorded health inside the window) on which the source appears in `failed`, and `failing_since`, the `date` of the oldest run in that streak. A run on which the source answered, was served by its fallback endpoint, or was not attempted ends the streak. A new public helper `health.streak(runs, reference, window, source)` returns `(streak_days, failing_since)` and `(0, None)` when the source did not fail the latest run. All previously emitted keys (`reference`, `window_days`, `threshold_days`, `runs_with_health`, `failures`, `fallbacks`, and `source`/`failed_days` inside `struggling`), the worst-first ranking, the threshold and latest-run rules, and `--fail-on-struggling` exit codes are unchanged. The module docstring and docs/automation.md explain the two fields.
